    Read the build at a glanceTarget rank is what you buy. Effective level adds board and gear bonuses; specialty picks use that effective level.
    How are ranks and green bonuses calculated?

    The green (+number) in game is separate from Mastery rank. The planner adds your chosen Daevanion route and any gear or Arcana levels you enter. Rank 9 plus green (+5) appears as Lv 14. Enter your current rank in a card to compare it with the recommended target. Specialty selections are recommendations; check live tooltips after a balance patch.         Set up the in-game macro

        Macro steps press hotbar keys, not typed skill commands. Keep the basic attack or filler held separately to weave it between skills.

        10 ms start
        LMB+RMB

        How to play the loop

        Keep the damage engine held, then add manual decisions on top.

        01 / BASE

        02 / WEAVEPress 1–8 over it

        03 / PAUSEStop auto casts on purpose

        Suggested 1–8 combat bar

        These are manual decisions during the held loop, not a 1 → 8 sequence. Defiance shares Space with jump/glide by default. Some classes have a free flex slot.

        Class-specific

        In-game setup

          Keep these manual

          During safe damage, keep the filler and in-game Macro key held while you press or hold manual skills. Manual input takes priority. Release Macro to stop its casts; release the filler too when all attacks must stop for mechanics or urgent healing. Keep charged attacks, toggles, movement and emergency skills on manual keys. A 10 ms macro step is an input delay, not a guaranteed cancel time; Global has minimum cancel delays. Test on a dummy and adjust for your ping. In AION 1 control mode, use a keyboard Macro bind.

          Fast collection wins

          1. Finish the Hero Episode story and join a Legion for easy owned effects.
          2. Use the Spacetime Rift 3 times for Hello There; 50 uses earns Nice to Meet You.
          3. Find Empyrean Traces to raise your faction's Monolith to 20 for Guardian and 30 for Saint.
          4. Clear the Sealed Dungeon Ruins of the Ancient City of Roah for Through Hell and Back.

          Longer goals: all Genus Insight at level 10 for Unbound by Genus; 200 pets for Rule All Creation; 25 wings for Dominator of Dimensions; 700 skins for Empty Closet.

          Research & limits

          Live links for the selected class and the assumptions behind the route.

          These are context-specific starting recommendations, not combat simulations or measured optima. The 1–8 hotbar placements are ergonomic suggestions. Specialty options were sourced from PvE guides; verify them before using a PvP preset. The 60k Templar tank and 100k damage Combat Power goals are editable planning benchmarks, not official dungeon requirements. Gear, boards, skills and other systems affect the in-game score; the game calculates the final number. Healers should measure effective healing and keep the party alive. Azphel PvP currency is separate.
